verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents pre-request scripts ("Snippets of code associated with a request that is executed before the request is sent") and AI-assisted authoring of pre-request scripts and test cases, and its CLI supports running test/collection scripts for automated pipelines, together covering chaining/data massaging via scripts. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation excerpt on post-response script API/environment variable setting syntax, and no independent hands-on validation of chaining behavior beyond doc claims.
